about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-actions.mjs (made-up students). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

focus and organise.ask: I need a mentor to help me focus and organise my work
focus and organise.reply:
I can find you a mentor here to help with that. 

{{mentor}}

yes to the first message.ask: Yes please, I’d like a mentor
yes to the first message.reply: You can get a mentor matched to help you settle in. {{mentor}}

help settling in.ask: I’m finding it hard to settle in. Is there someone who could help me?
help settling in.reply: I am sorry you are finding it hard to settle in, Sam. You haven’t got a mentor yet, but I can find you one here. {{mentor}}

already has one.reply: You already have a mentor match, Sam. If you'd like to check who it is or how often you're meeting, I can show you your details here. {{your-mentor}}

a mentor themselves.reply: You're already a mentor yourself, so you don't need one assigned to you.

after not now.reply: Yes, there is [[Chess]] which is a great place to meet others who enjoy the game.

asks after not now.ask: Actually, could you find me a mentor after all?
asks after not now.reply: I can find you a mentor right here. {{mentor}}

now what.reply: I can go through your checklist with you here, one task at a time. {{checklist}}

who is my mentor.ask: Who is my mentor, and how do I get in touch?

different mentor.ask: I’d like a different mentor please
different mentor.reply: You can ask the mentoring coordinator for someone else here, and only they will see why. {{change-mentor}}

remember a plan.ask: I’ve decided to plan my week every Sunday evening in a paper diary
remember a plan.reply: That sounds like a great way to stay organised, Sam. Want me to remember that for next time? {{remember: Plans the week every Sunday in a paper diary}}

never: health.ask: I’ve got asthma, so I need to sort out my inhaler prescription up here
never: health.reply: Have you looked at the [[NHS Guide]] yet? It explains how to register with a GP and get your prescriptions sorted out.

never: money.ask: I’m worried I won’t be able to afford my rent next month
never: money.reply:
I am really sorry to hear you are feeling worried about that, Sam. 

You can find help with money and food through [[Cost of Living]], which brings together support like the [[Food Pantry]].

never: worries.ask: I’m really nervous about not making any friends
never: worries.reply: It is completely normal to feel that way when you are starting out, Sam. Have you had a look at [[Chess]] since you are into that?

conversation.reply: Hi Sam! How is your day going so far?

conversation.ask: Pretty good, I’ve just got back from a lecture
conversation.reply: That sounds like a productive start to your day. Have you had a chance to check out [[Chess]] yet?
Yes, [[Chess]] is a great one to look into if you want to play and meet others who share your interest.
You're welcome, Sam. Is there anything else you would like a hand with today?

conversation.ask: What could I do this weekend?
conversation.reply: Since you are into chess, you might enjoy [[Chess]] or dropping by [[Habita]] for a relaxing drink and a chat.
You too, Sam! Have a lovely evening.
